method: Unmodified approved artwork copied locally; individual illustration regions rendered with CSS clipping/sprite positioning. No raster editing or generation.
coordinateSystem: All rectangles are [x,y,width,height] in the original 1024x1536 design source. Preserve the rectangle aspect ratio. Never display a whole design as the webpage.

hero-character.notes: Approved raised-hand bust pose; polygon intentionally excludes all heading/CTA text and white carousel background. Match hero blue beneath. Inspect contour at final size.

hero-bottle.notes: Decorative bottle with original blue light field; blend using CSS mask if necessary.

hero-workbench.notes: Photo plus laptop. Clip excludes main heading and first body line; small laptop UI labels are illustration detail.

value-smart.notes: Chat microcopy is part of the illustration; marketing paragraph remains HTML.

scene-beginner.notes: Character, speech bubble and output photo only, no section or card heading/body.

scene-video.notes: Decorative still storyboard including drawn timeline; no real video is provided.

marketing-video.notes: Static three-frame storyboard and drawn timeline.

marketing-app.notes: Computer/product still life only. Small screen UI text is illustration detail.

lingling-banner.notes: Raised-hand bust over original soft blue light; no banner headline/button included.

feature-video.notes: Static storyboard, not an actual media playback source.

feature-prompt.notes: Prompt bubble microcopy belongs to illustration; separate descriptive text must be DOM.

work-video.notes: Play glyph baked into reference. Wrap this region with a genuine accessible storyboard-preview button.

final-bottle.notes: Left ornament only, excludes banner heading/body/buttons.

final-product.notes: Right still life only; softly mask the left edge to blend into CSS blue background.

independentFiles.use: Fallback only; full-body pose differs from approved raised-hand hero, so do not use for the default hero.

limitations: Design-region visual assets are the approved 1024px-resolution pixels, so enlarged displays cannot gain photographic detail.
Hero-character contour and hero-workbench clipping require visual confirmation against the reference; do not hide DOM text with raster art.
Sources contain an entire design only as a sprite atlas; display solely the defined illustration regions, never full cards or full page segments.
